summary_en: The elephant will not move toward Makkah. The birds come. The House is saved.

paragraphs.ar: وَفِي الصَّبَاحِ، جَهَّزَ أَبْرَهَةُ جَيْشَهُ وَفِيلَهُ لِيَدْخُلَ مَكَّةَ. وَكَانَ اسْمُ الْفِيلِ مَحْمُودًا.
paragraphs.en: In the morning, Abraha readied his army and his elephant to enter Makkah. The elephant's name was Mahmud.

paragraphs.ar: فَجَاءَ رَجُلٌ اسْمُهُ نُفَيْلٌ، وَوَقَفَ بِجَانِبِ الْفِيلِ، وَأَمْسَكَ بِأُذُنِهِ.
paragraphs.en: A man named Nufayl came, stood beside the elephant, and took hold of its ear.
paragraphs.note: Nufayl ibn Habib al-Khath'ami, captured in episode 9 and made Abraha's guide.

paragraphs.ar: وَقَالَ لَهُ: «ابْرُكْ يَا مَحْمُودُ، أَوِ ارْجِعْ مِنْ حَيْثُ جِئْتَ، فَإِنَّكَ فِي بَلَدِ اللَّهِ الْحَرَامِ.»
paragraphs.en: He said to it: "Kneel, Mahmud — or go back where you came from. You are in the Sacred Land of Allah."

paragraphs.ar: ثُمَّ تَرَكَ أُذُنَهُ، وَهَرَبَ إِلَى الْجَبَلِ.
paragraphs.en: Then he let go of its ear and ran for the mountain.

paragraphs.ar: فَضَرَبُوهُ لِيَقُومَ، فَأَبَى. وَضَرَبُوا رَأْسَهُ، فَأَبَى.
paragraphs.en: They beat it to make it rise, but it refused. They struck its head, but it refused.

paragraphs.ar: فَوَجَّهُوهُ نَحْوَ الْيَمَنِ، فَقَامَ يَمْشِي مُسْرِعًا. وَوَجَّهُوهُ نَحْوَ الشَّامِ، فَمَشَى. وَوَجَّهُوهُ نَحْوَ الشَّرْقِ، فَمَشَى.
paragraphs.en: They turned it toward Yemen, and it got up and hurried off. They turned it toward Syria, and it walked. They turned it toward the east, and it walked.
Then they turned it toward Makkah — and it knelt.

paragraphs.ar: فَأَرْسَلَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ طَيْرًا مِنْ جِهَةِ الْبَحْرِ، مِثْلَ الْخَطَاطِيفِ.
paragraphs.en: Then Allah sent against them birds from the direction of the sea, like swallows.

paragraphs.ar: مَعَ كُلِّ طَائِرٍ ثَلَاثَةُ أَحْجَارٍ: حَجَرٌ فِي مِنْقَارِهِ، وَحَجَرَانِ فِي رِجْلَيْهِ. أَحْجَارٌ صَغِيرَةٌ، مِثْلَ الْحِمَّصِ وَالْعَدَسِ.
paragraphs.en: Each bird carried three stones: one in its beak, and two in its feet. Small stones, like chickpeas and lentils.

paragraphs.ar: لَا يُصِيبُ حَجَرٌ مِنْهَا أَحَدًا إِلَّا هَلَكَ. وَلَمْ تُصِبْهُمْ كُلَّهُمْ.
paragraphs.en: No one struck by one of those stones survived. But not all of them were struck.
paragraphs.note: Source: لا تصيب منهم أحدا إلا هلك، وليس كلهم أصابت.

paragraphs.ar: فَهَرَبَ الْجَيْشُ، يَبْحَثُونَ عَنْ طَرِيقِ الرُّجُوعِ، وَيَسْقُطُونَ فِي كُلِّ طَرِيقٍ.
paragraphs.en: The army fled, searching for the road home, falling along every path.

paragraphs.ar: وَبَقِيَتْ مَكَّةُ سَالِمَةً، وَبَقِيَ الْبَيْتُ فِي مَكَانِهِ.
paragraphs.en: And Makkah remained unharmed, and the House remained standing.

"Have you not seen how your Lord dealt with the People of the Elephant? Did He not make their scheme go astray? He sent against them birds in flocks, pelting them with stones of baked clay, and made them like chewed-up straw."
paragraphs.ar: ﴿أَلَمۡ تَرَ كَيۡفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصۡحَـٰبِ ٱلۡفِيلِ (١) أَلَمۡ يَجۡعَلۡ كَيۡدَهُمۡ فِى تَضۡلِيلࣲ (٢) وَأَرۡسَلَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ طَيۡرًا أَبَابِيلَ (٣) تَرۡمِيهِم بِحِجَارَةࣲ مِّن سِجِّيلࣲ (٤) فَجَعَلَهُمۡ كَعَصۡفࣲ مَّأۡكُولِۭ (٥)﴾

audio.source: Recorded by Shaykh AbdulAziz Salar Rasoul; used with permission

paragraphs.en: And that year was named "the Year of the Elephant."
paragraphs.note: Editor's line. Ibn Hisham uses عام الفيل as a date (the Prophet ﷺ was born عام الفيل) but does not narrate the naming.

paragraphs.ar: وَفِي هَذَا الْعَامِ نَفْسِهِ، سَيُولَدُ فِي مَكَّةَ طِفْلٌ.
paragraphs.en: And in this very year, a child would be born in Makkah.
refs: Ibn Hisham, Sira — Ibn Ishaq — birth in the Year of the Elephant
paragraphs.note: Ibn Ishaq: ولد رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم … عام الفيل. Deliberately unnamed; volume 2 opens on the birth. The old card said a woman 'was waiting for a child' at the time of the attack, which the source does not say.
